title: West Global Technology Center Recognized as a Top Global Capabilities Center at the GCC Workplace Awards
summary: West Global Technology Center was recognized at the GCC Workplace Awards 2026 for workplace culture, collaboration, employee engagement and talent growth.
body_markdown:
### Eecho Wang


### Senior Specialist, AP Communications


### September 10, 2026


# West Global Technology Center Recognized as a Top Global Capabilities Center at the GCC Workplace Awards


**Recently, West Global Technology Center (GTC) in Bangalore has been recognized as a Top Global Capabilities Center (GCC) at the GCC Workplace Awards 2026. This recognition highlights our commitment to building a healthy, innovative workplace where team members thrive.**


The GCC Workplace Awards is one of India's largest Workplace Innovation Summits that honors workplace excellence and innovation across Global Capability Centers. This recognition reflects the strong people practices, collaborative culture, and innovation-focused environment that continue to define West Bangalore GTC as a workplace of choice.


At our Bangalore site, key practices include creating a strong people-first culture, fostering collaboration, and aligning our teams closely with business priorities. By focusing on attracting and developing talent with growth opportunities, continuous learning, and an inclusive work environment, our team members are empowered to innovate, solve complex challenges, and deliver high-quality outcomes through cross-functional partnerships and shared accountability. The team also prioritizes employee engagement and wellbeing, recognizing that a motivated and supported workforce is essential to sustained performance. Together, these practices help build a workplace where people thrive, and business impact follows.


Hussain Rampurawala, Senior Manager, HR, D&T, mentioned: “Being recognized as a Top Global Capabilities Center is a key milestone for our Bangalore site. It reflects the strength of our people, our culture, and our shared commitment to excellence. We are proud to foster an environment where team members feel empowered to collaborate, contribute, and grow while advancing West’s mission of improving patient lives.”


Venkata Sreedhar Cherukuru, Senior Director, D&T, ERP Technical Arch & PLM, added: “I am incredibly proud of our GTC team, whose passion, commitment, and collaboration have made this recognition possible. Guided by the One West Way, our culture of innovation and continuous learning empowers our people to harness technology and digital capabilities to drive meaningful business transformation. I sincerely thank every team member for their contributions, which make our GTC a place where people are inspired to grow, empowered to innovate, and united by a shared purpose to make a meaningful difference.”


At West, we are committed to a purpose-led culture where every individual brings unique expertise and curiosity to the table.[Click here](https://www.westpharma.com/careers) to join a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued and contributions foster meaningful impact.
